about: Case 156's reject, no blank lines: the bullet moved from directly above the empty '## Rejected' heading to below it. `record` passes to verifying; then the migration-verifier fails and `findings --failed` undoes b1-u1. The copy below the heading is removed (the one the snapshot can't account for, not read as the heading), and the source line goes back under the nearest non-blank line above it in the snapshot, the ferry line. idea-tobias ends byte for byte as it was at run start, with no blank line added. undo-misses.json is []. One batch, so the run is at batches-done.
readings: The note is back to its run-start text exactly, because putting the line back under the ferry line restores the snapshot's order.
